title: Timeline
description: An animation timeline for an editor panel, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Toggle, Tooltip, Button and Slider primitives: play/pause and loop toggles with a "current / duration" readout in m:ss:ff, Add keyframe and Delete keyframe buttons, zoom out / zoom in / Fit buttons, a time ruler that is a single-thumb Slider (the playhead, with its time marks as markers, seconds then frames as you zoom in), and one row per animated property — a label that selects the track, then a Slider whose thumbs are its keyframes; a playhead line crosses every track. Controlled only: it renders tracks, time, playing, loop, the selected keyframe and zoom as given and reports every change (times snapped to 1 / fps), announcing the zoom level through announce() from @moderno-ui/core; it holds no clock. Space plays and pauses, Delete removes the selected keyframe, Page Up/Down move a thumb one second; zoom widens the time area, which scrolls sideways with the ruler and every track under a sticky label column and a sticky ruler; responds to its container (@container) — the label column widens at @sm and every ruler mark shows at @md.
